title: Identify pending accounts eligible for cleanup
gherkin:
Feature: Pending Account Cleanup
  Scenario: System identifies pending accounts that meet cleanup criteria
    Given the system has pending accounts in the database
    When the cleanup process scans for eligible pending accounts
    Then pending accounts meeting cleanup criteria are identified
    And the count of identified accounts is greater than zero
rationale: Verifies that the system can correctly identify which pending accounts are eligible for cleanup based on defined criteria.
generationSummary: Pending-account cleanup requirement generates test cases covering the identification, validation, and removal of pending accounts that meet cleanup criteria. Tests verify that pending accounts are properly identified, that cleanup operations execute correctly, and that system state is properly updated after cleanup.
